forum.title: STM32U073CCT6 LSE
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

You can refer to this knowledge base article: [How to select a compatible crystal and load capacitors for STM32 with layout guidelines](https://community.st.com/stm32-mcus-60/how-to-select-a-compatible-crystal-and-load-capacitors-for-stm32-with-layout-guidelines-148169)

Or for more details to the Application note [AN2867](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an2867-guidelines-for-oscillator-design-on-stm8afals-and-stm32-mcusmpus-stmicroelectronics.pdf) “Guidelines for oscillator design on STM8AF/AL/S and STM32 MCUs/MPUs”
forum.content_text:
Hi

We are developing a board with the STM32U073CCT6 CPU. Would it be possible to use a crystal with the following characteristics for the LSE?

32.768KHz Cl=6pF/ESR=50kR

In this case, what would be the recommended capacitor values?

BR

Gilberto
